blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A driver's week is a pattern. It repeats every week. On Monday, Harry plans the routes. In the middle of the week, he makes many deliveries. On Friday, he does the wrap-ups and checks his work.

In English, we use "on" with days of the week. We say "on Monday" and "on Fridays". We use the Present Simple to talk about weekly habits, because the same things happen again and again.

A clear week means fewer surprises. Drivers like a routine they can trust. They know the team's schedule by heart. On Saturday, Harry works only for emergencies, and at the weekend he rests.

items.q: What does Harry do on Monday?
items.why: "On Monday, Harry plans the routes."

items.q: Which preposition does English use with days of the week?
items.why: "we use 'on' with days of the week" — on Monday, on Fridays.

items.q: Why does the text use the Present Simple?
options: Because it talks about next year
Because the same things happen every week
Because the actions happen only once
Because it talks about the past
items.why: "We use the Present Simple to talk about weekly habits" — hábitos que se repetem.

items.q: The text suggests that Harry would most likely AGREE that…
options: Monday is a day to rest
a driver should change plans every day
a routine you can trust is a good thing
items.why: Inferência: "A clear week means fewer surprises" e "Drivers like a routine they can trust".

items.q: What does "on Saturday he works only for emergencies" suggest about Saturday?
options: It is the busiest day of the week
It is a normal, busy work day
It is usually a quiet day off
items.why: Inferência: se ele trabalha só em emergências, o sábado costuma ser calmo/de folga.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry descrever a rotina da semana. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, I'm Harry. Let me tell you about my week as a driver. My week is a pattern, and I like it that way.

On Monday, I check the truck and I plan the routes. I like a calm start, so I begin early, at seven in the morning. I also call the team and we talk about the plan. On Tuesday and on Wednesday, I make deliveries around the city. These are my busy days, and I drive a lot.

On Thursday, I visit the clients who are far away. It is a long day, but I enjoy it, because the roads are quiet. On Friday, I finish the reports and I clean the truck. I call Friday my wrap-up day. It is a good feeling to close the week.

On the weekend, I rest. On Saturday, I only drive for emergencies, so my phone is on all day. On Sunday, I stay at home with my family and I do not think about work.

I know my schedule by heart. The same days, the same plan, every week. A clear week gives me fewer surprises, and that is why I feel calm and happy in this job.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What time does Harry start on Monday?
items.why: "I begin early, at seven in the morning."

items.q: Which days are his busy delivery days?
items.why: "On Tuesday and on Wednesday, I make deliveries… These are my busy days."

items.q: What does Harry do on Friday?
options: He finishes the reports and cleans the truck
items.why: "On Friday, I finish the reports and I clean the truck."

items.q: Why does Harry keep his phone on during the weekend?
options: To call his clients on Sunday
In case there is an emergency on Saturday
items.why: Inferência: "On Saturday, I only drive for emergencies, so my phone is on."

items.q: How does Harry feel about his week?
options: Calm, because the plan is clear
items.why: Inferência: "A clear week gives me fewer surprises… that is why I feel calm."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We have a meeting on Monday at nine." Monday is…
items.why: Monday = segunda-feira, o primeiro dia útil da semana.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The big delivery is in the middle of the week, on ___."
items.why: Wednesday = quarta-feira, o meio da semana.

items.q: "See you on Friday for the wrap-up." Friday is…
items.why: Friday = sexta-feira, o último dia útil da semana.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Harry rests and stays home at the ___."
items.why: Weekend = fim de semana, o período de descanso (sábado e domingo).

items.q: "He drives all week, from Monday to Friday." A week is…
items.why: Week = semana, o período de sete dias.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho de um motorista. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "On Friday, Harry likes to wrap up the week." To wrap up means to…
items.why: Wrap up = finalizar, fechar o que estava em andamento.

items.q: "He drops off the boxes at the client's door." To drop off means to…
items.why: Drop off = deixar/entregar algo em um lugar.

items.q: "Before he leaves, he picks up the next order." To pick up means to…
items.why: Pick up = pegar/recolher algo.

items.q: "Harry checks in with the team every morning." To check in means to…
options: give a quick update or contact someone
items.why: Check in = dar um retorno rápido, se comunicar com a equipe.

items.q: "Traffic was bad, so the truck ran late." To run late means to…
items.why: Run late = estar atrasado, chegar depois da hora.
